round_assessment.reason: Every completed prime row equals twice the original actual wave. Completed-row Cauchy returns the inherited GAR X^(1/12+epsilon) bound. The full positive allocation and incidence certificates cost X^(1/8), hence physical X^(3/8), worse than inherited X^(1/3). A separately reviewed actual grouped-coefficient semiprime control also shows a loss in its stated prime range, but none of these is a signed lower bound. No complete bound improves.
